issues.on_page: Total Governmental Funds column is on p7
issues.issue: receipts[0]-[3] (Property 2,162,400, Motor vehicle 243,398, Special assessments 61,667, Occupation/franchise 3,386,771) cite p6. The amounts are right, but they appear on p6 only because they equal the General/Street fund columns. The Total column that the rules call for is on p7.

issues.on_page: Grants 579,210 = General 42,096 + CDBG 101,461 + Capital Projects 188,390 + nonmajor 247,263 (Creative District 99,428, Aviation 147,835)
issues.issue: Creative District grants are probably state money (Nebraska Arts Council). The source of the General Fund department grants (Police 2,852, Convention Center 38,244, Library 1,000) and the Capital Projects grants is not stated, so 'federal grants' is uncertain. The same applies to detail[20], detail[21], detail[22], detail[216] and detail[221]. CDBG (detail[199]) is federal.
Repayments of CDBG loans are a loan-principal inflow, not unexplained revenue. Whether to keep them in 'other' or treat them as financing is a judgment call. The same applies to detail[200].
The list has no airport function, so 'other' with review is defensible. 'economic development' or 'general government' are alternatives. The same applies to detail[228].

issues.on_page: Senior Center column (Salaries and benefits 437, Repairs 4,804, Utilities 8,956, total 14,197), part of Environment and leisure
issues.issue: The category rules put senior services under health/welfare. The report groups Senior Center under Environment and leisure (p14), so culture/recreation is defensible. The same applies to detail[111] and detail[130].

issues.on_page: Operating expenses: Transportation (Parks 12,602, Police 30,770; p23 Ball Park 5,744, Fire/EMS 26,757)
issues.issue: 'Transportation' could be vehicle costs (fuel, repairs) rather than travel. The lines carry review notes. The same applies to detail[120]-[122].

The extractor assumed the object for each department's capital outlay: equipment purchases for detail[160] and [162]-[170], and construction/infrastructure for detail[161] (Capital Projects department 5,908,201). The page prints no object, so 'not itemized' would also fit. The lines carry review notes.

Following the rules, the rural fire contract is filed under charges for services, but the page prints it under Intergovernmental revenue. On the statement (p6) it is inside General Fund Intergovernmental 662,701, so receipts[6] and the detail disagree on its category. The line carries a review note.
A Street Fund's intergovernmental revenue is usually mostly highway allocation, but the page doesn't say so. 'other state aid' is defensible.

issues.on_page: Total Governmental Funds: Certificates of deposit 12,384,934; County treasurer cash 113,132
issues.issue: ending_cash uses only 'Cash and cash equivalents' 6,040,239, and the 12.38M of certificates of deposit is recorded only in the notes. The CDs could go in ending_investments. The notes explain the choice.
